```{r}
### REGIONAL RRHO TRANSCRIPTIONAL-PROGRAM NETWORK

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(RedRibbon)
```

```{r}
### SETTINGS

output_dir <- "05_regional_RRHO_network"

rrho_map_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "pairwise_RRHO_maps"
)

rrho_object_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "pairwise_RRHO_objects"
)

go_table_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "leading_edge_GO_tables"
)

go_plot_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "leading_edge_GO_plots"
)


dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

dir.create(
  rrho_map_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

dir.create(
  rrho_object_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

dir.create(
  go_table_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

dir.create(
  go_plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


target_regions <- c(
  "dSTRr",
  "NAS",
  "PIRc",
  "dSTRc",
  "S1c"
)


# A gene must be detected in at least 10% of spots in either
# condition in at least two target regions.

minimum_pct <- 0.10
minimum_regions_expressed <- 2L


# Permutation-adjusted quadrant statistics are used to mark
# supported edges in the network.

run_permutations <- TRUE
permutation_support_cutoff <- 0.05


# Setting the seed makes the evolutionary search reproducible.

rrho_seed <- 27072026L


# Run GO enrichment on the RRHO leading-edge genes.

run_go_enrichment <- TRUE

go_adjusted_p_cutoff <- 0.05
go_min_genes <- 10L
go_top_terms_per_set <- 10L

```

```{r}
### CHECK REQUIRED INPUT

required_columns <- c(
  "gene",
  "region",
  "avg_log2FC",
  "pct.1",
  "pct.2"
)


missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(deg_table_all)
)


if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "deg_table_all is missing: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


if (
  !"p_val" %in% colnames(deg_table_all) &&
  !"p_val_adj" %in% colnames(deg_table_all)
) {

  stop(
    "deg_table_all must contain p_val or p_val_adj."
  )
}


missing_regions <- setdiff(
  target_regions,
  unique(
    as.character(
      deg_table_all$region
    )
  )
)


if (length(missing_regions) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "The following target regions are absent: ",
      paste(
        missing_regions,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
### CHOOSE THE P-VALUE USED FOR RANKING

# Raw p-values retain more ranking resolution and are therefore
# used when available.
# Adjusted p-values are used only as a fallback.

if ("p_val" %in% colnames(deg_table_all)) {

  ranking_p_column <- "p_val"

} else {

  ranking_p_column <- "p_val_adj"

  warning(
    paste0(
      "p_val was not found. ",
      "RRHO ranking will use p_val_adj."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "P-value column used for RRHO ranking:",
  ranking_p_column,
  "\n"
)


```

```{r}
### PREPARE ONE ROW PER GENE AND REGION

deg_rrho <- deg_table_all %>%
  mutate(
    gene = trimws(
      as.character(gene)
    ),
    region = as.character(region),
    avg_log2FC = as.numeric(avg_log2FC),
    pct.1 = as.numeric(pct.1),
    pct.2 = as.numeric(pct.2),
    p_for_rank = as.numeric(
      .data[[ranking_p_column]]
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    region %in% target_regions,
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != ""
  ) %>%

  # If duplicate gene-region rows exist, retain the row with
  # the smallest ranking p-value.

  group_by(
    gene,
    region
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    is.na(p_for_rank),
    p_for_rank,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(
    maximum_pct = case_when(
      is.na(pct.1) & is.na(pct.2) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ pmax(
        pct.1,
        pct.2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),

    sufficiently_expressed =
      !is.na(maximum_pct) &
      maximum_pct >= minimum_pct
  )

```

```{r}
### REPLACE ZERO P-VALUES SAFELY

positive_p_values <- deg_rrho$p_for_rank[
  is.finite(
    deg_rrho$p_for_rank
  ) &
  deg_rrho$p_for_rank > 0
]


if (length(positive_p_values) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No finite positive p-values were found."
  )
}


p_value_floor <- max(
  min(
    positive_p_values,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) / 10,
  1e-300
)


deg_rrho <- deg_rrho %>%
  mutate(
    p_for_rank_safe = case_when(
      is.na(p_for_rank)     ~ 1,
      p_for_rank <= 0       ~ p_value_floor,
      p_for_rank > 1        ~ 1,
      TRUE                  ~ p_for_rank
    ),

    signed_rrho_score =
      sign(avg_log2FC) *
      -log10(p_for_rank_safe)
  )


```

```{r}
### DEFINE ONE FIXED GENE UNIVERSE

# The same genes are used for every region pair.
# This avoids pair-dependent gene universes.

eligible_gene_table <- deg_rrho %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions_present = n_distinct(region),

    n_regions_expressed = sum(
      sufficiently_expressed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    complete_fold_change = all(
      is.finite(avg_log2FC)
    ),

    complete_rrho_score = all(
      is.finite(signed_rrho_score)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_regions_present == length(target_regions),
    n_regions_expressed >= minimum_regions_expressed,
    complete_fold_change,
    complete_rrho_score
  )


eligible_genes <- eligible_gene_table$gene


cat(
  "Genes in the fixed five-region RRHO universe:",
  length(eligible_genes),
  "\n"
)


if (length(eligible_genes) < 100) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Only ",
      length(eligible_genes),
      " genes passed the RRHO filters."
    )
  )
}


write.csv(
  eligible_gene_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "RRHO_fixed_gene_universe.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
### CONSTRUCT GENE-BY-REGION RRHO SCORE MATRIX

rrho_score_table <- deg_rrho %>%
  filter(
    gene %in% eligible_genes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    region,
    signed_rrho_score
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = region,
    values_from = signed_rrho_score
  )


rrho_score_table <- rrho_score_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    all_of(target_regions)
  )


write.csv(
  rrho_score_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_signed_RRHO_score_matrix.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
### HELPER FUNCTIONS

safe_scalar <- function(
  x,
  default = NA_real_
) {

  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    length(x) == 0 ||
    !is.finite(as.numeric(x)[1])
  ) {

    return(default)
  }

  as.numeric(x)[1]
}


extract_quadrant_statistics <- function(
  quadrant_object,
  quadrant_name
) {

  p_value <- safe_scalar(
    quadrant_object$pvalue
  )

  adjusted_p_value <- safe_scalar(
    quadrant_object$padj
  )

  log_p_value <- safe_scalar(
    quadrant_object$log_pvalue
  )

  log_adjusted_p_value <- safe_scalar(
    quadrant_object$log_padj
  )


  # RedRibbon reports natural-log significance.

  log10_p_value <- if (
    is.finite(log_p_value)
  ) {

    log_p_value / log(10)

  } else if (
    is.finite(p_value) &&
    p_value > 0
  ) {

    -log10(p_value)

  } else {

    NA_real_
  }


  log10_adjusted_p_value <- if (
    is.finite(log_adjusted_p_value)
  ) {

    log_adjusted_p_value / log(10)

  } else if (
    is.finite(adjusted_p_value) &&
    adjusted_p_value > 0
  ) {

    -log10(adjusted_p_value)

  } else {

    NA_real_
  }


  enrichment_direction <- safe_scalar(
    quadrant_object$direction
  )


  # Positive direction indicates enrichment.
  # Negative direction indicates depletion.

  enrichment_strength <- if (
    is.finite(enrichment_direction) &&
    enrichment_direction > 0 &&
    is.finite(log10_p_value)
  ) {

    log10_p_value

  } else {

    0
  }


  tibble(
    quadrant = quadrant_name,
    p_value = p_value,
    adjusted_p_value = adjusted_p_value,
    log10_p_value = log10_p_value,
    log10_adjusted_p_value =
      log10_adjusted_p_value,
    enrichment_direction =
      enrichment_direction,
    overlap_count = safe_scalar(
      quadrant_object$count,
      default = 0
    ),
    enrichment_strength =
      enrichment_strength
  )
}


minimum_finite <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {

    return(NA_real_)
  }

  min(x)
}


sanitize_filename <- function(x) {

  gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
    "_",
    x
  )
}

```

```{r}
### DEFINE ALL TEN REGION PAIRS

region_pairs <- t(
  combn(
    target_regions,
    2
  )
)


pair_summary_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = nrow(region_pairs)
)


quadrant_summary_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = nrow(region_pairs)
)


leading_edge_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = nrow(region_pairs) * 4
)


leading_edge_index <- 1L

```

```{r}
### RUN ALL PAIRWISE REDRIBBON ANALYSES

for (
  pair_index in seq_len(
    nrow(region_pairs)
  )
) {

  region_1 <- region_pairs[
    pair_index,
    1
  ]

  region_2 <- region_pairs[
    pair_index,
    2
  ]


  pair_id <- paste0(
    region_1,
    "_vs_",
    region_2
  )


  cat(
    "\nRunning RRHO:",
    pair_id,
    "\n"
  )


  pair_input <- data.frame(
    id = rrho_score_table$gene,
    a = rrho_score_table[[region_1]],
    b = rrho_score_table[[region_2]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  if (
    any(!is.finite(pair_input$a)) ||
    any(!is.finite(pair_input$b))
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Non-finite RRHO score detected for ",
        pair_id
      )
    )
  }


  set.seed(
    rrho_seed + pair_index
  )


  rrho_object <- RedRibbon::RedRibbon(
    pair_input,
    enrichment_mode = "hyper-two-tailed"
  )


  quadrant_object <- RedRibbon::quadrants(
    rrho_object,
    algorithm = "ea",
    permutation = run_permutations,
    whole = FALSE
  )


  saveRDS(
    list(
      input = pair_input,
      rrho = rrho_object,
      quadrants = quadrant_object
    ),
    file.path(
      rrho_object_dir,
      paste0(
        pair_id,
        "_RedRibbon_object.rds"
      )
    )
  )
  
  # Save RRHO Map
  
    rrho_plot <- RedRibbon::ggRedRibbon(
    rrho_object,
    quadrants = quadrant_object,
    labels = c(
      region_1,
      region_2
    ),
    repel.force = 250
  ) +
    coord_fixed(
      ratio = 1,
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Rank-rank hypergeometric overlap: ",
        region_1,
        " vs ",
        region_2
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Ranking: -log10(",
        ranking_p_column,
        ") × sign(log2FC)"
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      )
    )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      rrho_map_dir,
      paste0(
        pair_id,
        "_RRHO_map.pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = rrho_plot,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 8,
    height = 7,
    units = "in"
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      rrho_map_dir,
      paste0(
        pair_id,
        "_RRHO_map.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = rrho_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 7,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )

  
  # Extract quadrant statistics
  
  quadrant_statistics <- bind_rows(
    extract_quadrant_statistics(
      quadrant_object$upup,
      "upup"
    ),

    extract_quadrant_statistics(
      quadrant_object$downdown,
      "downdown"
    ),

    extract_quadrant_statistics(
      quadrant_object$updown,
      "updown"
    ),

    extract_quadrant_statistics(
      quadrant_object$downup,
      "downup"
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      region_1 = region_1,
      region_2 = region_2,
      pair_id = pair_id,
      .before = 1
    )


  quadrant_summary_list[[
    pair_index
  ]] <- quadrant_statistics

  
  # Extract leading-edge genes
  
  quadrant_names <- c(
    "upup",
    "downdown",
    "updown",
    "downup"
  )


  for (
    quadrant_name in quadrant_names
  ) {

    current_quadrant <-
      quadrant_object[[quadrant_name]]


    current_positions <-
      current_quadrant$positions


    if (
      is.null(current_positions) ||
      length(current_positions) == 0
    ) {

      next
    }


    current_positions <- unique(
      as.integer(current_positions)
    )


    current_positions <- current_positions[
      current_positions >= 1 &
      current_positions <= nrow(pair_input)
    ]


    if (length(current_positions) == 0) {

      next
    }


    current_statistics <-
      quadrant_statistics %>%
      filter(
        quadrant == quadrant_name
      )


    leading_edge_list[[
      leading_edge_index
    ]] <- pair_input[
      current_positions,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ] %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      transmute(
        pair_id = pair_id,
        region_1 = region_1,
        region_2 = region_2,
        quadrant = quadrant_name,
        gene = id,
        score_region_1 = a,
        score_region_2 = b,

        quadrant_p_value =
          current_statistics$p_value,

        quadrant_adjusted_p_value =
          current_statistics$adjusted_p_value,

        quadrant_log10_p_value =
          current_statistics$log10_p_value,

        enrichment_direction =
          current_statistics$enrichment_direction
      )


    leading_edge_index <-
      leading_edge_index + 1L
  }

  # Summarize the pair for network construction
  
  upup_stats <- quadrant_statistics %>%
    filter(
      quadrant == "upup"
    )

  downdown_stats <- quadrant_statistics %>%
    filter(
      quadrant == "downdown"
    )

  updown_stats <- quadrant_statistics %>%
    filter(
      quadrant == "updown"
    )

  downup_stats <- quadrant_statistics %>%
    filter(
      quadrant == "downup"
    )


  upup_strength <-
    upup_stats$enrichment_strength

  downdown_strength <-
    downdown_stats$enrichment_strength

  updown_strength <-
    updown_stats$enrichment_strength

  downup_strength <-
    downup_stats$enrichment_strength


  concordant_strength <- max(
    upup_strength,
    downdown_strength,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  discordant_strength <- max(
    updown_strength,
    downup_strength,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  direction_denominator <-
    upup_strength +
    downdown_strength


  direction_balance <- if (
    is.finite(direction_denominator) &&
    direction_denominator > 0
  ) {

    (
      upup_strength -
      downdown_strength
    ) /
    direction_denominator

  } else {

    0
  }


  relationship_type <- if (
    concordant_strength >=
    discordant_strength
  ) {

    "Concordant"

  } else {

    "Discordant"
  }


  dominant_concordant_direction <- case_when(
    upup_strength >
      downdown_strength ~ "Up/up",

    downdown_strength >
      upup_strength ~ "Down/down",

    TRUE ~ "Balanced"
  )


  concordant_adjusted_p <- minimum_finite(
    c(
      if (
        upup_stats$enrichment_direction > 0
      ) {
        upup_stats$adjusted_p_value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },

      if (
        downdown_stats$enrichment_direction > 0
      ) {
        downdown_stats$adjusted_p_value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  )


  concordant_raw_p <- minimum_finite(
    c(
      if (
        upup_stats$enrichment_direction > 0
      ) {
        upup_stats$p_value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },

      if (
        downdown_stats$enrichment_direction > 0
      ) {
        downdown_stats$p_value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  )


  supported <- if (
    is.finite(concordant_adjusted_p)
  ) {

    concordant_adjusted_p <
      permutation_support_cutoff

  } else if (
    is.finite(concordant_raw_p)
  ) {

    concordant_raw_p <
      permutation_support_cutoff

  } else {

    FALSE
  }


  pair_summary_list[[
    pair_index
  ]] <- tibble(
    region_1 = region_1,
    region_2 = region_2,
    pair_id = pair_id,

    upup_strength = upup_strength,
    downdown_strength =
      downdown_strength,

    updown_strength =
      updown_strength,
    downup_strength =
      downup_strength,

    concordant_strength =
      concordant_strength,

    discordant_strength =
      discordant_strength,

    direction_balance =
      direction_balance,

    relationship_type =
      relationship_type,

    dominant_concordant_direction =
      dominant_concordant_direction,

    concordant_raw_p =
      concordant_raw_p,

    concordant_adjusted_p =
      concordant_adjusted_p,

    supported = supported,

    upup_overlap_count =
      upup_stats$overlap_count,

    downdown_overlap_count =
      downdown_stats$overlap_count,

    updown_overlap_count =
      updown_stats$overlap_count,

    downup_overlap_count =
      downup_stats$overlap_count
  )
}

```

```{r}
### COMBINE AND EXPORT RRHO RESULTS

pairwise_rrho_summary <- bind_rows(
  pair_summary_list
) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(concordant_strength)
  )


quadrant_rrho_summary <- bind_rows(
  quadrant_summary_list
) %>%
  arrange(
    pair_id,
    quadrant
  )


leading_edge_genes <- bind_rows(
  leading_edge_list
) %>%
  distinct(
    pair_id,
    quadrant,
    gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


write.csv(
  pairwise_rrho_summary,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_pairwise_RRHO_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  quadrant_rrho_summary,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_RRHO_quadrant_statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  leading_edge_genes,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_RRHO_leading_edge_genes.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nPairwise RRHO summary:\n"
)

print(
  pairwise_rrho_summary
)

```

```{r}
### CONSTRUCT COMPLETE REGIONAL RRHO NETWORK

# All ten pairwise edges are retained.
# No edge threshold and no forced module assignment are used.

network_edges <- pairwise_rrho_summary %>%
  transmute(
    from = region_1,
    to = region_2,

    concordant_strength =
      concordant_strength,

    discordant_strength =
      discordant_strength,

    direction_balance =
      direction_balance,

    relationship_type =
      relationship_type,

    dominant_concordant_direction =
      dominant_concordant_direction,

    supported = factor(
      supported,
      levels = c(
        FALSE,
        TRUE
      )
    ),

    concordant_adjusted_p =
      concordant_adjusted_p,

    edge_width_value = pmax(
      concordant_strength,
      1e-6
    )
  )


# Nodes deliberately have no quantitative size encoding.

node_table <- tibble(
  name = target_regions
)


regional_graph <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = network_edges,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = node_table
)


# Fixed circular layout.
# Node position has no quantitative interpretation.

network_angles <- seq(
  pi / 2,
  pi / 2 - 2 * pi,
  length.out = length(target_regions) + 1
)[
  seq_along(target_regions)
]


network_layout <- tibble(
  name = target_regions,
  x = cos(network_angles),
  y = sin(network_angles)
)


vertex_order <- V(regional_graph)$name


layout_x <- network_layout$x[
  match(
    vertex_order,
    network_layout$name
  )
]


layout_y <- network_layout$y[
  match(
    vertex_order,
    network_layout$name
  )
]


rrho_network_plot <- ggraph(
  regional_graph,
  layout = "manual",
  x = layout_x,
  y = layout_y
) +

  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      width = edge_width_value,
      colour = direction_balance,
      alpha = supported,
      linetype = relationship_type
    ),
    lineend = "round"
  ) +

  geom_node_point(
    size = 13,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 1
  ) +

  geom_node_text(
    aes(
      label = name
    ),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_edge_width_continuous(
    name = "Concordant RRHO\nstrength (-log10 p)",
    range = c(
      0.5,
      5
    ),
    trans = "sqrt"
  ) +

  scale_edge_colour_gradient2(
    name = "Direction of\nconcordant overlap",
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "grey85",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(
      -0.3,
      0.3
    ),
    breaks = c(
      -0.3,
      0,
      0.3
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Down/down",
      "Balanced",
      "Up/up"
    )
  ) +

  scale_edge_alpha_manual(
    name = "Permutation-adjusted\nsupport",
    values = c(
      `FALSE` = 0.25,
      `TRUE` = 0.90
    ),
    labels = c(
      `FALSE` = paste0(
        "padj ≥ ",
        permutation_support_cutoff
      ),
      `TRUE` = paste0(
        "padj < ",
        permutation_support_cutoff
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_edge_linetype_manual(
    name = "Dominant relationship",
    values = c(
      Concordant = "solid",
      Discordant = "dashed"
    )
  ) +

  coord_equal(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Regional shared-transcriptional-program network",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "RRHO of ranked SNI-versus-sham responses; ",
      "all ten regional relationships shown"
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      25,
      40,
      25,
      40
    ),

    legend.position = "right"
  )


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_RRHO_shared_program_network.pdf"
  ),
  plot = rrho_network_plot,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_RRHO_shared_program_network.png"
  ),
  plot = rrho_network_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

write.csv(
  network_edges,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "regional_RRHO_network_edges.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
### GO-BP ENRICHMENT OF CONCORDANT LEADING-EDGE GENES

if (run_go_enrichment) {

  if (
    !requireNamespace(
      "clusterProfiler",
      quietly = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "clusterProfiler is required because ",
        "run_go_enrichment = TRUE."
      )
    )
  }


  if (
    !requireNamespace(
      "org.Mm.eg.db",
      quietly = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "org.Mm.eg.db is required because ",
        "run_go_enrichment = TRUE."
      )
    )
  }


  concordant_leading_edges <- leading_edge_genes %>%
    filter(
      quadrant %in% c(
        "upup",
        "downdown"
      ),
      enrichment_direction > 0
    )


  enrichment_groups <- concordant_leading_edges %>%
    group_by(
      pair_id,
      region_1,
      region_2,
      quadrant
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      genes = list(
        unique(gene)
      ),
      n_genes = n_distinct(gene),
      .groups = "drop"
    )


  enrichment_result_list <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = nrow(enrichment_groups)
  )


  for (
    enrichment_index in seq_len(
      nrow(enrichment_groups)
    )
  ) {

    current_group <-
      enrichment_groups[
        enrichment_index,
      ]


    current_genes <-
      current_group$genes[[1]]


    if (
      length(current_genes) <
      go_min_genes
    ) {

      next
    }


    current_enrichment <-
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene = current_genes,

        universe = eligible_genes,

        OrgDb =
          org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,

        keyType = "SYMBOL",

        ont = "BP",

        pAdjustMethod = "BH",

        pvalueCutoff = 1,

        qvalueCutoff = 1,

        minGSSize = 10,

        maxGSSize = 500,

        readable = TRUE
      )


    current_enrichment_df <-
      as.data.frame(
        current_enrichment
      )


    if (
      nrow(current_enrichment_df) == 0
    ) {

      next
    }


    current_enrichment_df <-
      current_enrichment_df %>%
      mutate(
        pair_id =
          current_group$pair_id,

        region_1 =
          current_group$region_1,

        region_2 =
          current_group$region_2,

        quadrant =
          current_group$quadrant,

        n_leading_edge_genes =
          current_group$n_genes,

        .before = 1
      )


    enrichment_result_list[[
      enrichment_index
    ]] <- current_enrichment_df


    current_output_name <- paste0(
      current_group$pair_id,
      "_",
      current_group$quadrant
    )


    write.csv(
      current_enrichment_df,
      file.path(
        go_table_dir,
        paste0(
          sanitize_filename(
            current_output_name
          ),
          "_GO_BP.csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )


  }  # closes the enrichment for-loop


  all_leading_edge_go <- bind_rows(
    enrichment_result_list
  )


  write.csv(
    all_leading_edge_go,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "all_RRHO_leading_edge_GO_BP_results.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )



  # Individual GO plots with global fixed scales


  all_plot_df <- all_leading_edge_go %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(p.adjust),
      p.adjust < go_adjusted_p_cutoff
    ) %>%

    group_by(
      pair_id,
      region_1,
      region_2,
      quadrant
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      p.adjust,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%

    slice_head(
      n = go_top_terms_per_set
    ) %>%

    ungroup() %>%

    mutate(
      GeneRatio_numeric = vapply(
        strsplit(
          GeneRatio,
          "/"
        ),
        function(x) {
          as.numeric(x[1]) /
            as.numeric(x[2])
        },
        numeric(1)
      ),

      minus_log10_padj = -log10(
        pmax(
          p.adjust,
          1e-300
        )
      )
    )


  if (
    nrow(all_plot_df) > 0
  ) {

    # Global limits used identically in every plot

    global_gene_ratio_max <- max(
      all_plot_df$GeneRatio_numeric,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )


    global_colour_limits <- range(
      all_plot_df$minus_log10_padj,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )


    if (
      diff(global_colour_limits) == 0
    ) {

      global_colour_limits <-
        global_colour_limits +
        c(
          -0.5,
          0.5
        )
    }


    plot_groups <- all_plot_df %>%
      distinct(
        pair_id,
        region_1,
        region_2,
        quadrant,
        n_leading_edge_genes
      )


    for (
      plot_index in seq_len(
        nrow(plot_groups)
      )
    ) {

      current_group <-
        plot_groups[
          plot_index,
        ]


      current_plot_df <- all_plot_df %>%
        filter(
          pair_id ==
            current_group$pair_id,

          quadrant ==
            current_group$quadrant
        ) %>%

        arrange(
          p.adjust
        ) %>%

        mutate(
          Description = factor(
            Description,
            levels = rev(
              unique(
                Description
              )
            )
          )
        )


      current_output_name <- paste0(
        current_group$pair_id,
        "_",
        current_group$quadrant
      )


      current_direction_label <- ifelse(
        current_group$quadrant == "upup",
        "shared upregulated program",
        "shared downregulated program"
      )


      go_plot <- ggplot(
        current_plot_df,
        aes(
          x = 1,
          y = Description
        )
      ) +

        geom_point(
          aes(
            size = GeneRatio_numeric,
            colour = minus_log10_padj
          )
        ) +

        scale_size_area(
          name = "Gene ratio",
          max_size = 10,
          limits = c(
            0,
            global_gene_ratio_max
          ),
          breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(
            n = 4
          ),
          labels = scales::percent_format(
            accuracy = 1
          )
        ) +

        scale_colour_gradient(
          low = "#fcbba1",
          high = "#67000d",
          name = "-log10\nadjusted p",
          limits = global_colour_limits,
          breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(
            n = 4
          ),
          oob = scales::squish
        ) +

        scale_x_continuous(
          breaks = NULL
        ) +

        labs(
          title = paste0(
            current_group$region_1,
            "–",
            current_group$region_2,
            ": ",
            current_direction_label
          ),

          subtitle = paste0(
            current_group$n_leading_edge_genes,
            " RRHO overlap genes"
          ),

          x = NULL,
          y = NULL
        ) +

        theme_bw() +

        theme(
          panel.grid =
            element_blank(),

          plot.title =
            element_text(
              face = "bold"
            ),

          axis.text.x =
            element_blank(),

          axis.ticks.x =
            element_blank(),

          axis.text.y =
            element_text(
              size = 8
            )
        )


      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(
          go_plot_dir,
          paste0(
            sanitize_filename(
              current_output_name
            ),
            "_GO_BP_dotplot.pdf"
          )
        ),
        plot = go_plot,
        device = cairo_pdf,
        width = 7,
        height = 6,
        units = "in"
      )
    }
  }
}  # end GO enrichment
```
